[h2]
No place is too cool for PositronX this summer 😎🥵[/h2]

Ain’t no rest from the tropical heat waves engulfing this [b]Summer Sale[/b]. Good thing that in PositronX you will always be in the shades while mowing through endless waves of machines. 
We don’t know if they have been driven mad by the scorching temperature, but just to make sure everyone can get in the fun we slashed the price by [i][b]50%[/b][/i].

With no danger of overheating or succumbing to the fever of fun, [i]Atom[/i] is the character you can always count on to reach the boss and send it packing with the unleashed fury of all the furnaces of Hell.

So close the shades, make sure you stay hydrated and see how fiery the action gets in PositronX!

[i]Have a great Summer,
The Scorpius Crew[/i]

notes.title: Happy Lunar New Year, Positrons!
notes.content:
[h2]🏮Happy Lunar New Year, Positrons🏮[/h2]

We are welcoming the Year of the Ox with a 20% discount for all the machine blasting enthusiast out there.

It is believed that Oxen are the hard workers in the background, intelligent and reliable, but never demanding praise.

We like to think that if our characters would have a specific creation year, Proton would be created in the Year of the Ox. 
Loyal to it's purpose and very sturdy, Proton is the character you can always count on to steadily push through countless waves of machines and still have enough resources to face the boss.
Like all the other oxen in our lives, Proton is definitely one of our favorites and the one to call when worst comes to worst.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32123945/534fd328a724cefa412b29564c1e13b34923a046.png[/img]

May this new year bring happiness, health and good fortune to all of you!

Have a happy and healthy year,
[i]The Scorpius Crew[/i]

_run Happy Holiday Wishes.w/creepy(Robot voice)... standby

[b][h3]Happy Holidays, Positrons![/h3][/b]

[img]https://media1.tenor.com/images/29b9456973ced74d7af6df0433e6f4ab/tenor.gif?itemid=19338398[/img]

It seems you have almost completed one of the toughest roguelite stages in recent history - the year 2020. It’s hard to say what 2020 DIDN’T have: a raging pandemic, suffocatingly tense elections, more online flame wars than we could’ve ever expected and much, much more. 2020 has been a tough cookie. But it had its moments.

For us at Scorpius Games, it’s been the release of PositronX, a little nugget of joy in a sea of stress. And for us there’s no better way to relieve stress than blasting, crushing, shredding, pounding and obliterating entire rooms of enemies at a time. 

[img]https://media1.tenor.com/images/be2b5bb2e8c5b8c484b0b2879d05f168/tenor.gif?itemid=18251486[/img]

And what better time to do that than now, in the snug comfort of your home, boasting your ugliest Christmas sweater and downing mug after mug of the cinnamon-y beverage of your choice, all while trying to get that Sinatra song out of your head, the one you probably heard over two days ago at the mart. Ugh. Yes, blasting robots helps. It always does.

[img]https://media1.tenor.com/images/b892b8650a4bef73e648266aead4f085/tenor.gif?itemid=18251480[/img]

And to that end, we’re overriding the standard pricing protocol and we’re implanting a [b]20% discount[/b]. Wallets need love too, we know that, PositronX has you covered. 

Oh, and if you decide to spend part of your holidays crushing robots, share your robo-murder work on our community! We’d love to see a gallery of Winter-y fireworks to keep us warm.

And don’t forget to say “Hello” on our [url=https://discord.gg/AY5dE38c ! ]Discord [/url]server ! 

Happy Holidays to you all!

Signed
[i]-the Scoripius Crew[/i]

notes.title: Nominate PositronX for "The best game you suck at" award!
notes.content:
We have always had a special place in our hearts for games that encouraged creative problem solving but also made you feel like a badass, so we knew from the start that PositronX will be a game about tight gameplay above all else.

The first person perspective opens up an entire array of gameplay possibilities but we wanted it to be a game that is both challenging while also giving a sense of freedom when it comes to how a player can approach a situation.

This is how Positronx came to be a futuristic [b]rogue-lite [/b]fps featuring fast-paced combat, creative movement, time control mechanics and breathtaking visuals, each playthrough giving you a unique experience.

[b]Without further ado:[/b]

[i]For all the times you tried every weapon and you still could not clear the room...[/i]
[img]https://media1.tenor.com/images/94585bc5fa402b6c8a451763b61a7f8e/tenor.gif?itemid=18977516[/img]

[i]For all the times you forgot to look down and got blasted by Rollers...[/i]
[img]https://media1.tenor.com/images/e8c31397ffbae76a46307d26cc8f467e/tenor.gif?itemid=19326874[/img]

[i]For all the times you activated the implant a second too late...[/i]
[img]https://media1.tenor.com/images/02c7827980fcda368f1ba2901f152825/tenor.gif?itemid=18251471[/img]

Embrace your love-hate relationship with the rogue-lite elements from PositronX and nominate us for "The best game you suck at" award!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32123945/09e9cdaa634d496448bac3eed8b9ba193464456c.jpg[/img]



Sincerely,
[i]The Scorpius Crew[/i]

notes.title: Farewell Early Access, thanks for all the help!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=f4wdktWdWiU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]It all started when...[/h2]

4 years ago we set on this journey to create the game that encompasses the core mechanics we loved and wished for in our favorite games. 

4 years ago we longed for “the good ol’ days”. We wanted  gunplay, we wanted tight gameplay, we wanted to control time, to control space, to blast trough some enemies with big guns but to sneak behind others, to feel the rush of a gaming session that will never be the same twice.

2 years ago we noticed we weren't the only ones, so we launched our game into early access, eager to listen to other gamers around the world who longed for the same game as we did.  And so, PositronX grew and evolved as our community supported and guided us with precious feedback and insight we might have otherwise missed.

Every step of our journey, has led to this moment. 

[h2]Today, PositronX leaves Early Access![/h2]

[i]PositronX fireworks[/i]
[img]https://media1.tenor.com/images/cf7817642ab5d6edb00638339f88a4f2/tenor.gif?itemid=18972529[/img]

Our project evolves into PositronX v1.0.0 today and with it some new feature have been added to round out and complete your PositronX experience.

3 new characters are waiting for you in the lobby, ready to test their mettle against the machines. Joining Positron, Proton, Electron and Atom will be:
[list]
[*] Quark - a silent but deadly assassin, 
[*] Neutron - a devastating damage dealer 
[*] Graviton - a master of Time. 
[/list]

The arsenal at your disposal has increased with two new weapons to unload on your opponents: the Core gun and Time gun. 

[img]https://media.tenor.com/images/487b5fd5997aada5686f793bb4d8eea3/tenor.gif[/img]

Pick your character, upgrade your weapons, install your implants and get ready to explore the 4th stage of the game. 

And this wouldn't be a proper roguelite without... you guessed it, the final boss at the end of the final stage - [b]Machina[/b].

[i]if you can get past them...[/i]
[img]https://media1.tenor.com/images/be2b5bb2e8c5b8c484b0b2879d05f168/tenor.gif?itemid=18251486[/img]

[h2]PositronX leaves Early Access with a 10% discount for the launch week![/h2]

To celebrate leaving Early Access we took a shot at the price and managed to deal a 10% damage for a whole week (October 29th - November 5th). 

[i]Take that, price![/i]
[img]https://media1.tenor.com/images/94585bc5fa402b6c8a451763b61a7f8e/tenor.gif?itemid=18977516[/img]

It has been a long road and we want to thank each and everyone of you for helping us in our journey!

[h3]Without further ado we present you PositronX v1.0.0! [/h3]
We had an amazing time making it, we hope you'll have an amazing time playing it ːsteamhappyː.


Happy robot hunting,
[i]The Scorpius Crew[/i]

notes.title: PositronX reaches 15 weapons! Better Shooting, More Optimizations & Implants.
notes.content:
Hello Dear Players,
We are happy to announce that PositronX is expanding. A big update just hit our Early Access version! Here is what's new:
- Number of weapons is now 15! Two more weapons are Disk Gun and Cannon Gun. We are very proud that we've been able to reach this number of guns in the game (since all our weapons support 2 shooting modes, 2 modifiers and tons of upgrades). We still have a few more to go but 15 is a nice selection, don't you think?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32123945/80f6382ab34fe96b44a1b1576656035d77010745.jpg[/img]

- Aiming and hitting enemies have improved drastically. Hit boxes and projectile-enemy hit detection are adjusted to give more satisfying results.
- Content and game build process optimizations (we now only ship the content that the game needs to run. There is a lot of content we used to work in map editing which was not yet used in the final game so this is now being removed. Size of final game is now decreased by 25% and loading times are minimized for both initial screen as well as the in-between levels. This has been an ongoing effort on our side for several months and should significantly improve the loading times for everybody!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32123945/ecaa47ebb5490c6a629676d8742da2d6b0d1cd08.jpg[/img]

- Started on improving secret areas and hidden levels. They are active in only some of the maps but we will enable this in most maps eventually (it will make the game a bit more difficult for people who like to search for stuff but we believe it will also make it more enjoyable).
- More Implants are in (we've yet to reach the number of Implants we've planned for this Summer update but this is our main focus for the next update).
- First version of Achievements is in (most of them are inactive still as we are testing internally), but more and more will get to be available with each update.
- Progression system has been adjusted to make it feel more interesting.
Thank You for playing our game and supporting us,

For a full change log please read here https://steamcommunity.com/app/529970/discussions/3/1640918469767464457/

notes.title: Dev Diary #1 - FOV
notes.content:
[b]FOV or field of view[/b] is a very important feature in FPS games, especially for PC gamers. Its history goes back to the [b]Quake games[/b] where a larger field of view was used in multiplayer games as an advantage, allowing you to see more of the surroundings and spot enemies around you.

Since this project started on the PC, we’ve always designed the game with options such as FOV in mind for maximum comfort. [b]PositronX[/b] by default is set to 90 degrees field of view as it’s common for PC shooter games and it feels alright. In many ways, you could say, it’s optimal.
This is how [b]PositronX[/b] looks with the default FOV now:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32123945/97c481e74027f213f26051a52bdb606fe80f4fa1.jpg[/img]
 
However, soon after releasing on [b]Early Access[/b] we started to think about the ranges of FOV for the players to adjust to. We thought it was as simple as coming up with any extremes that still looked good on the monitor, but we soon discovered it’s not quite that simple.
Our first setup was from [b]60 to 110 [/b] and it [b]felt fine[/b]. The lowest setting was too low for a PC game, but we figured console players would probably want to try out the game themselves and so it was a good incentive to leave that in, while 110 felt good ([b]Doom[/b] plays great with 110 FOV).
Changing the field of view when using Unreal Engine is a piece of cake, we added all these options and boom, done, we had it and shipped in one of our monthly updates.
60/110 FOV looked like this:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32123945/3f443f5cf1d9dbe8c8d07014cc103856c702634b.png[/img]
[b]FOV of 60 without corrected projection[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32123945/1e385e04fa1abb481f4a4a297b38aa61b81819c4.png[/img]
[b]FOV of 110 without corrected projection[/b]

People mostly played with the default (90 degrees) so there was no feedback for a while about it. I think they were either happy with that setting or they didn't even notice the option. Luckily, after a while, the messages started flowing in and were overwhelmingly positive, at least as far as inclusion of FOV slider goes. [b]There was a problem[/b] in there, however, that we knew we needed to address. People who used non-standard settings started noticing it.
Higher field of view makes the weapons and hands look unnaturally long and flimsy. While we knew about the technical issue, we didn't realize this can influence someone's decision about playing the game (especially since it was an early alpha), yet we soon began reading comments from people who actually decided against giving [b]PositronX[/b] a chance because of this.
Here's what a larger FOV did to our character and weapons:

[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/DenseInsecureHake-size_restricted.gif[/img]

Unfortunately, there is nothing out of the box [b]Unreal Engine[/b] can offer to help you with this issue, so we had to look for a custom solution that would make things look normal again. We searched for games with a similar problem in the past and we find quite a few ideas on how to solve it.
One fix was using the [b]Panini projection[/b] of which we were aware since UE4 has some support for it. When applied as a post-processing effect, it made the rendered image look good but there were some artifacts showing up. We couldn't fix those artifacts in a way that would deem the current UE4 post-processing solution as usable in our case.
However, after reading multiple articles about it and banging our heads a bit, we finally came to a definitive solution. We would only apply the Panini calculations to our hands and weapons (and a few other elements we later found out we needed to). If we could undo the calculus they've done and input that to our first person hands and weapons (displacements in the vertex shader) we should be good to go.
The calculus itself turned out to be something bearable (with the help of a now-deceased game called [b]Unreal Tournament[/b]) and looked something like this:
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32123945/d573d973e4fa67d219e6400eee0ffe5449e446d6.png[/img]
Vertex displacement shader function

Once we had that we made a function we used in all our shaders that required it. The final result was that our first person hands and weapons still looked like they were being rendered at 90 degrees while everything else would use the FOV the player setup. This was a huge gain because we could increase our [b]maximum FOV limit to 130[/b]. Here is how this looks in the game:

[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/DopeyLankyHeron-size_restricted.gif[/img]

There are still a few drawbacks about this, some of which we fixed in later updates. Because the hands and weapons were visually displaced in the shader, everything related to their in-game location had to use the same projection shader function to work properly (for example, each weapon has a point at the end of the barrel where bullets spawn after being fired). Also, each effect that happens at the start of the weapon barrel (muzzle flashes for example) needed to be using it as well. There were all these sorts of small stuff that needed multiple tries to get it to look good enough to ship.


Something that remained to be fixed is the self-shadowing of the weapon onto itself. This is bad now (because of the displacement of the vertices in the shader) and we disabled it. Luckily for us, it’s barely noticeable and it gives us a slight performance boost anyway so it's not a real issue.


All in all, it was a nice feature we knew we wanted to have but we weren't aware of the importance of it until feedback came in. The road was bumpy, but we did what we could to give the players the best possible experience while playing [b]PositronX[/b].

Thank you for reading this, let us know in the comments if you enjoy this sort of content and would like to know more about the development process in the future :)

notes.title: PositronX - 2019 Roadmap
notes.content:
Today we have something very exciting to share with you. Below you will find our official roadmap for year 2019. Do keep in mind that some things may change over the course of the development, but at the same time you can look at this schedule as a sort of indicator of where we’re going with the game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32123945/caaa93f37fd815abf4d9ebe5902e57b30fecd1cd.png[/img]

http://www.scorpiusstudios.com/uploads/games_media/3cd6d-forecast.png

We started off with our recent Spring update that brought with it 4 enemy types and brand new stage to fight on. 

[h1][b]Summer 2019 [/b][/h1]
The next update will happen this summer and it’ll bring the Disc Gun for you to spin the party with as well as a truckload of new and crazy abilities. To top it all off, you can count on more imprints and challenging achievements.

[h1][b]Autumn 2019 [/b][/h1]
Will feature an even greater number of brand new additions. This fall you’ll be able to test two guns (including incredibly fun Time Gun) against powerful Chargers on Machine Core stage. All this can be used with one of three new characters. And don’t forget about more imprints and abilities!

[h1][b]Winter 2019 [/b][/h1]
We’ll close this year with winter update - and it’ll be the biggest one yet. New stage, more guns, more enemies, more abilities, more imprints, more characters, more achievements, everything that your hearts desire. 

Stay tuned for more info!

For a more detailed list of stuff and released builds take a look here https://steamcommunity.com/app/529970/discussions/0/1696043806550745106/

notes.title: Machine Factory stage, four new Enemies and more performance optimizations!
notes.content:
Hello, Machine Warriors!

It's been some time since the release of the previous update and believe us when we say that it was time well spent! This time we've got something extremally exciting for you - a new playable stage in the form of machine factory drowned in smoke and heat. There are also four new enemies joining the roster for you to disintegrate!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32123945/756eb92782dadf81d26f97fd62318e03a4d32316.jpg[/img]

Additionally, the Machine Factory Update will bring a lot of improvements to optimization, almost every system in the game, as well as new original soundtrack pieces and tons of bug fixes. 

This release is the first step into our new roadmap, but more on that will be revealed soon. Stay tuned!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FF6h4IScbuk

*** Known issue ***

Rarely, when switching between 2 weapons, the hands/weapon will disappear. If this happens exit the game to main menu and then choose play and Continue (the game already saved the progression to current room so you will always restart from where you were).

Key features in Machine Factory Update:
[list]
[*]New stage - Machine Factory
[*]New Enemy - Slicer (2 blade enemy that can kill you in one hit)
[*]New Enemy - Blade Runner (small but fast enemy, very dangerous in groups)
[*]New Enemy - Daemon (heavy enemy, impervious to time manipulation)
[*]New Boss - Tripod (3 legged robot that delivers a mighty melee attack)
[*]Max FOV of 130 (+ constant FOV for weapon and FPS hands)
[*]Optimizations on both loading time and rendering performance. The game should run 20%  better and loading times should have decreased to normal times.
[*]Fine grained performance options (Shadows, Textures, Antialiasing, Post processing, Effects)
[/list]

For a more detailed change log please take a look here https://steamcommunity.com/app/529970/discussions/3/3491891042515758205/

notes.title: New Weapon : Nail Gun, Faster playable characters, 25 new Imprints and lots of Optimizations
notes.content:
Version 0.7.9 is out now. This release focuses on optimizations as well as expanding the options and fine tuning characters. The speed of playable characters increased by 20% for an even more dynamic gameplay, new weapon added : Nail Gun and set as the starting weapon for our newest character, Atom. 
We also spent quite a while on optimizing the rendering performance in maps with outside environment as well as resource loading while completely revamping the Enforcer and Heavy Enforcer characters and Soliders animations.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32123945/7da3fcadaf9cd7170f3cbb4c42fad6cb80572961.jpg[/img]

Key points in this release are:
- Faster speed of movement for all playable characters
- Teleporting now works from anywhere in the room once you cleared it (don't have to go to the teleporter to move to a new room)
- New weapon : Nail Gun (starting weapon for our newest character, Atom)
- Enforcer and Heavy Enforcer characters completely revamped
- Animations for Soldier characters revamped, Advanced Soldier walking speed decreased
- 25 new Imprints that affect gameplay in ways we haven't before
- Crafting Imprints and Crafting Weapons terminals added
- Optimizations on rendering performance and resource loading

For a more detailed log please follow this link https://steamcommunity.com/app/529970/discussions/3/1742231069939571257/

notes.title: New character : Atom, Open Area outside environment, More playable-extended maps, Revamped music, More Implants

Our focus has been to heighten the initial impression with the game but also to make everything more interesting and fun for people already playing the game.

- New open area theme and new maps added
- New character : Atom (technical character, defenders manipulation specialist)
- More Implants and thus more combinations possible
- Stage 1 lighting and graphics improved, maps extended
- Music revamped completely (we removed the current theme with a more industrial/rock dynamic approach)
- Each character has 3 starting perks now instead of one 
- Hard Reset game mode changed
- Jump pads

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32123945/291a00b6c46cfd2522ff8eeec5f0bfc3eb02c4c0.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Tutorial, All maps redesigned, Zero G Fields, Redefine-able input for keyboard/controller - PositronX 0.7.5 Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32123945/c8215fc01e414282bb5e0a89e47861f7b6835cf8.jpg[/img]

We have skipped a version (from 0.7.3 to 0.7.5) because of the amount of changes we've done this month. Version 0.7.4. was somewhere in between and it didn't make sense to release it as a standalone version.

[h1]Keypoints[/h1]
As part of our efforts in easing new users into playing the game we have implemented a basic tutorial which should address that for new players. Also we have redefine-able keyboard and controller input.
Our main bulk of work has been spent on improving on every map in the game, changed completely the graphical theme for the first stage and improved and updated part of the theme for stage 2 and redesigning all maps at the same time. There are more details, decals and coherency in color theme for maps in both stages. We also started on adding support for Spatial Anomalies, the first one being a Zero G Field. Plus, tons of adjustments and fixes to the game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32123945/64f78df218805f0d63bf54fe849b29b36b2871e5.jpg[/img]

All of our resources are going towards having Stage3 asap in the application, playable and fun.

notes.title: Streamlining fighting experience - PositronX 0.7.3 Update
notes.content:
This update focuses on streamlining the fighting experience of PositronX. Enemies are easier to kill now but health and ammunition are scarce. Also Implant's cooldowns only update while in combat.
We had to postpone rebind keys/full controller support in UI for a later update.

notes.title: Game+, Local Leaderboards, Basic Controller support coming in 0.7.2 PositronX Update
notes.content:
We just released out second update since Early Access Release two weeks ago and we've made some major advancements in features we wanted to support 'asap' when E.A. started as well as added new features people playing the game asked for.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32123945/6309f7925fabb5a997fb42d6c6a5cf72c58a33aa.jpg[/img]

[h1]Game+ [/h1] Keep playing the game on higher difficulty levels with the same character
[h1]Local Leaderboards[/h1] Measure how well they've played against previous best scores
[h1]Controller support[/h1] Play with a controller (basic support, will complete in the next update)
[h1]No crosshair option[/h1] For veterans and courageous people as well

There are a lot of other features and fixes that made their way through, please read this thread for more details https://steamcommunity.com/app/529970/discussions/3/2828702372997594397/

notes.title: PositronX releases today April 27th, as an Early Access title!
notes.content:
After two and a half years in development [b]PositronX[/b] is released today, April 27th, as an Early Access title.   

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32123945/6309f7925fabb5a997fb42d6c6a5cf72c58a33aa.jpg[/img]

  We wish to thank everybody who played the closed Alpha version and helped us shape the game to the version we have today. Starting tomorrow everybody can experience the rogue-lite First Person Shooter experience of PositronX.

  Thank you!
